provenance.query: SELECT ts_recv, symbol, bar_start_ms, open, high, low, close, volume, src, schwab_ts, native_json FROM stream_bars_raw WHERE symbol=? AND bar_start_ms>=? AND bar_start_ms<? ORDER BY bar_start_ms, ts_recv
provenance.note: every receipt, each row as stored; a minute Schwab sent more than once has a row per receipt
